title: Understanding Creative Design Practices among Data Artists
summary: Creative and artistic data visualizations communicate stories and invite engagement, yet how designers develop their expressive forms remains poorly understood. We investigate the design process of data artists through three complementary studies: an analysis of 40 public project accounts, artifact-anchored interviews with seven experienced data artists, and a design task-based study with eight data artists.
